speaker: Doctor
text: The CBC shows elevated white blood cells despite normal inflammatory markers; do you have a fever or chills, and have you noticed any night sweats or unintentional weight loss? Given your enlarged supraclavicular lymph nodes, let me examine your neck and abdomen.

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for those details; the combination of fever/chills, drenching night sweats, and significant weight loss alongside lymphadenopathy is highly concerning for malignancy. Can you tell me if you have any history of alcohol consumption or if the abdominal pain is specifically in the epigastric region? Also, have you noticed any changes in your stool color or any jaundice?
